account.title: Welcome back.
account.lead: A home for your vehicle care. Orders, service requests and your vehicles will appear here after you sign in with your mobile number.

assistant.title: MechDost assistant
assistant.subtitle: Quick answers about products, workshops and orders
assistant.greeting: Hi! I can help you find products, get a workshop estimate, ask for a bulk-order price or reach our team. What do you need?
assistant.note: Automated answers. For anything urgent, WhatsApp {phone}.
assistant.a_shop: Browse the shop by category or search for a product, brand or part number. Our team confirms price, stock and delivery for your PIN before an order is accepted.
assistant.a_workshop: Tell us your vehicle and what it needs. A nearby workshop proposes a slot and expected cost, and work starts only after you approve the itemised estimate.
assistant.a_bulk: For bulk orders you can negotiate the price directly with the MechDost team. Share the products and quantities and we will reply with a final price for your order.
assistant.a_track: Once you sign in, your orders and service requests show live status in your account. Until then, message us your order reference on WhatsApp.
assistant.a_partner: Shops, garages and mechanics can apply on the partners page. Our team reviews each application and contacts you.
assistant.a_contact: You can reach the MechDost team on WhatsApp or by phone at {phone}.
assistant.a_fallback: I am still learning. Try one of the suggestions, or message our team on WhatsApp for a quick reply.
